jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (Dutch required)
jobs.description: Krijg jij energie van recruitment en wil je impact maken op onze teams en groei? Dan pas jij bij deze rol! Je brengt mensen en organisatiebehoeften samen: je spot talent, maakt verbinding en begeleidt kandidaten van eerste contact tot onboarding. Door jouw sterke samenwerking met hiring managers en stakeholders ben je niet alleen uitvoerend bezig, maar ook adviserend. Je bouwt aan een duurzaam partnership met de business en wordt gezien als een echte business partner. Je draagt bij aan het bouwen van high-performing tech teams die écht impact maken bij onze klanten. Jouw rol Als Talent Acquisition Specialist bij HSO ben je de drijvende kracht achter onze groeiambities. Jij weet als geen ander dat de juiste mensen op de juiste plek het verschil maken. Je werkt nauw samen met hiring managers en HR om talent aan te trekken dat niet alleen past bij de functie, maar ook bij onze cultuur en toekomstvisie. Recruitment is van groot belang voor de ontwikkeling en groei van ons bedrijf. Jouw rol is daarmee doorslaggevend in het succes van de organisatie. HSO is een internationale en toonaangevende Microsoft-partner. Vorig jaar is HSO erkend als Microsoft Partner of the Year. Jouw inspanningen helpen ons om die status te bevestigen en verdere groei te realiseren. Wat ga je doen? Jij bent dé expert in het vinden van tech talent: van het scherpstellen van de behoefte met hiring managers tot het sourcen van de juiste kandidaten en het begeleiden van hun eerste stappen in ons proces; Je zorgt voor een soepele samenwerking met hiring managers en vertaalt hun wensen naar een gerichte sourcingstrategie; Je bouwt sterke talent pipelines op, weet talent werkzoekenden te identificeren en aan je te binden , de markt heeft geen geheimen voor jou; Samen met arbeidsmarktcommunicatie zorg je voor de juiste zichtbaarheid op de juiste plekken of het nu via social media, communities of nichekanalen is; Je bent aanwezig op relevante beurzen, meetups en events en weet hier langdurige connecties o

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Sourcer, Strategic and Leadership Hiring
jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Our Strategic & Leadership Hiring team leads Director, Senior Director, VP and C-suite hiring across functions and global locations. We’re looking for an experienced, research-led recruiter to deliver the market insight, candidate engagement and initial assessment behind these business-critical searches. You’ll own research, sourcing and screening for assigned roles, turning complex briefs into thorough talent maps and credible shortlists. This is a hands-on opportunity to take ownership, work closely with senior stakeholders and help shape Checkout.com ’s leadership teams. What you’ll be doing Turn role briefs into focused search plans. Build thorough company and talent maps, understanding organisational structures, role scope and transferable experience to identify strong candidates beyond the obvious talent pools. Write tailored outreach that gives senior, passive candidates a compelling reason to engage. Build rapport, communicate the opportunity credibly and sustain interest through thoughtful follow-up. jobs.title: HR People Associate - Working Student
jobs.description: En bref En tant que HR People Associate chez Picnic, tu prendras en charge l’administration RH du quotidien pour nos équipes à Paris. En lien direct avec notre People Partner France, tu veilleras à ce que chaque étape administrative soit réalisée dans les temps : de la préparation de l’arrivée d’un nouveau collègue au suivi de son contrat, en passant par les demandes RH du quotidien. Tu seras responsable du suivi de tes propres sujets, de la collecte des documents aux dernières relances, en veillant à ce que rien ne passe entre les mailles du filet. Une fois ces responsabilités bien maîtrisées, tu pourras élargir ton périmètre à certaines activités administratives de nos équipes People aux Pays-Bas et en Allemagne. Tes missions Gérer l’administration de l’onboarding : collecter les documents nécessaires, coordonner les étapes administratives et t’assurer que tout est prêt pour le premier jour de chaque nouvelle recrue. Assurer le suivi des documents RH : préparer les contrats, avenants, attestations et courriers à partir de nos modèles, coordonner leur validation et leur signature, puis veiller à leur bon classement. Garantir la fiabilité des dossiers RH : tenir les données et les outils à jour, suivre les échéances et relancer les interlocuteurs concernés jusqu’à la résolution de chaque sujet. Organiser le suivi de la médecine du travail : planifier les rendez-vous, gérer les convocations et veiller au respect des échéances administratives. Piloter le suivi administratif des véhicules de fonction (lease cars) : coordonner les échanges avec les prestataires, préparer les documents nécessaires et suivre les livraisons comme les restitutions. Être le premier point de contact pour les demandes RH courantes : apporter une réponse aux questions administratives, assurer le suivi des demandes et solliciter le People Partner lorsque la situation le nécessite. Améliorer nos processus au quotidien : identifier les tâches qui pourraient être simplifiées, clarifier les checklis

jobs.title: Manager, GTM Talent Acqusition
jobs.description: At ClickUp , we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. Curious to see ClickUp Brain in action? Skip the JD below and check out the artifact here . ClickUp is redefining the future of work with AI and our TA team is at the center of that mission. We're evolving how we hire, building toward a future where AI takes on more of the heavy lifting so our recruiters can invest more deeply in what matters most: a genuinely human experience. There's lot of work to be done and we want someone excited to help us build this. We're betting that as we build more with AI, the human touch becomes increasingly important. That's why we want this leader based in New England to scale our Boston GTM hub with the kind of magic that only happens in person: hosting events, building talent community, and developing the relationships that make every GTM seller in Boston know our name before they're even looking. You're a player-coach who still loves the craft and is ready to multiply it. In this Manager, Talent Acquisition role you lead a pod of recruiters, carry your own req load of quota-carrying GTM roles, and own hiring for a major slice of our sales org across multiple hiring managers and regions all while building the future with AI. As a function we've been focused on thinking big, building small, shipping fast. We want YOU to lead from the front and accelerate that for your pod, measuring what ships, not how many agents you launched. The Role: Lead and coach your team. Run 1:1s, pipeline reviews, real-time feedback, own performance and career conversations, and set the bar on quality, speed, partnership, and candidate experience. Be a player coach. Carry your own load of quota

jobs.title: Senior Business Recruiter (12-Month Contract)
jobs.description: At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.  If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value. THE WORK: Are you a seasoned Business Recruiter looking for a chance to define an impact? Look no further! Ripple is seeking a Senior Business Recruiter to join our dynamic team and help us bring in top talent to drive our growth and innovation forward. As the Senior Business Recruiter, you will be a crucial part of the recruiting process, owning the process from start to finish and partnering closely with hiring managers to identify, attract and retain top talent. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a versatile team and play a key role in crafting the future of Ripple. You will work closely with our Talent Acquisition leader to build and implement a recruiting strategy that aligns with our strategic objectives while providing an outstanding candidate experience. Join us and be part of a company that is a leading provider of digital asset infrastructure for financial institutions WHAT YOU’LL DO: Own the recruiting process from sourcing to offers for multiple positions across the company. jobs.title: Sr. Total Rewards Manager
jobs.description: Hi! I’m Rachel and I lead People Operations here at Ashby . I recently joined and I’m excited that we're expanding our team! The People Operations Team provides support to Ashby employees through the development and implementation of programs, policies, and services that contribute to a productive and inclusive working environment. We ensure that the work we do aligns with our Operating Principles and strengthens the environment we're building at Ashby. Our approach is to do things differently – we prioritize what truly fits our team and enhances how we work together. By embracing creativity and customization, we aim to create a people-first culture that drives both individual and organizational success. We review all applications, and there isn’t a benefit to applying quickly. Take your time, look at the application questions and please submit before the application deadline! We aren’t able to take calls outside of the interview process, so reaching out to the team won’t push your application forward. About the Role We’re looking for an experienced Total Rewards leader to build and own Ashby’s total rewards function through our next phase of growth. This is a builder’s role. Some of the foundation is in place; a lot of it isn’t. You’ll set the philosophy, design the frameworks, build the infrastructure, and run the work day to day. It’s a chance to shape how a company rewards its people rather than administer decisions someone else made. It’s also unusually analytical, and unusually creative. Ashby’s Total Rewards philosophy is principled and intentionally not one-size-fits-all: approaches vary by function, because different parts of the business compete in different talent markets. jobs.description: Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes. Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together. About the People Team Our HR Business Partners are business leaders first, HR leaders second. We hold ourselves to a high standard of understanding the objectives, culture, and talent capabilities of our clients, and we quickly identify trends and solve problems in service of Thumbtack’s goals. While we value data and facts, we believe just as strongly in the intangibles — judgment, EQ, and an inclusive mindset by default. We strive to be trusted partners and coaches to people at every level of the organization. About the role We’re hiring an Sr. HRBP with a knack for operations and AI solutions building — someone who can spot high-impact opportunities to apply AI across HRBP workflows and help build those solutions. You’ll embed with the HRBP team to learn how the organization works, then partner closely with the team to turn the most valuable opportunities into products, such as an exit interview synthesizer or an engagement survey action planner that eliminates manual work. This role spans three pillars — client-facing HRBP support, AI and operations, and employee relations support — and reports to the Director of HR Business Partners. jobs.title: Manager of Talent Acquisition
jobs.description: About Karbon Karbon is the global leader in AI-powered practice management software for accounting firms. We provide an award-winning cloud platform that helps tens of thousands of accounting professionals work more efficiently and collaboratively every day. With customers in 40 countries, we have grown into a globally distributed team across the US, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Philippines. We are well-funded, ranked #1 on G2, growing rapidly, and have a people-first culture that is recognized with Great Place To Work® certification and on Fortune magazine's Best Small Workplaces™ List. We are seeking a player-coach style Manager of Talent Acquisition to own and elevate our global recruitment function. This is an owner-operator role: you will lead by example, personally closing roles, while managing a small team of recruiters and overseeing operational excellence across all open roles. Reporting to the VP of People, you will continuously refine how recruitment operates at Karbon - from candidate experience to process optimization, reporting, and AI integration. At the core, this role needs someone who: is obsessed with data and making recruitment more scientific a stickler for attention to detail a true talent partner not an order taker thinks AI-first and constantly look for ways to use AI to improve efficiency and delivery. About the Role: Recruiting Operations, Performance & Forecast Ownership Lead and scale the recruiting function with a sales-operator mindset, setting clear monthly and quarterly hiring targets aligned to headcount plans and business priorities. Manage recruiting performance like a revenue organization, using ramp expectations, activity targets, and pipeline coverage ratios to drive predictable hiring outcomes. Establish and maintain data-driven management systems that monitor pipeline health, diagnose breakdowns, and trigger tactical interventions to improve velocity, conversion, and quality. jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
jobs.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients. We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started. The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it ! Context This role is open to support an ambitious hiring goal: growing the team by 50%. You will join a team of three recruiters, alongside Léa, our Talent Lead, with whom you will work hand in hand. The priority of the role is hiring tech profiles: Senior Fullstack Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers and AI Engineers. Your missions Hire the best tech talent Gather hiring needs with Hiring Managers, co-build scorecards, then write and publish job offers. Source active and passive candidates through multiple channels, with a strong focus on headhunting (LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, events). Assess candidates and run hiring processes end to end in Ashby, through to the offer. Ensure a high-quality candidate experience at every step. Support Hiring Managers Be their point of contact and help them define their team strategy through hiring. Contribute to the recruiting team Contribute, alongside Léa, to improving our hiring processes and our employer brand. You you are : 2 to 4 years of experience in recruiting. Solid headhunting experience, especially on tech profiles, ideally gained in a SaaS

jobs.title: Contracts Manager Federal
jobs.description:
$100,000 - $120,000 a year Akicita Federal, LLC is a growing 8(a) small business that delivers healthcare, professional, and administrative services to federal agencies. We're adding a contracts manager to help us grow beyond our current work. The job is to find opportunities, write winning proposals quickly, and build lasting relationships with agencies and teaming partners. What you'll do Find and respond to federal opportunities, focusing on small business and 8(a) set-asides Write, assemble, and submit proposals at high volume, often turning one around in a day or two Manage contracts after award: point of contact for agencies, modifications, compliance, and reporting Spend about a quarter of your time on teaming and partnership outreach to other small businesses Work with our recruiting team to staff new awards Use AI tools to work faster. We expect speed and don't want proposals built by hand from scratch. What you bring 3+ years in federal contracting: contracts management, proposal writing, capture, or program management Solid understanding of the FAR, set-aside programs, and the federal procurement process An existing network of agency or contractor relationships is a strong plus You're comfortable with AI tools, or eager to become a power user You'd rather submit ten good proposals than polish one forever

jobs.title: Human Resources Intern
jobs.description: The Organization & Employee Development Intern will support the HR team in employee engagement activities, training and development, and organization development. The role involves assisting with planning, coordination, documentation, and program support while gaining practical experience in HR operations and communication. Core Responsibilities: Documentation & Logistics Support: Assist in preparing HR program materials, coordinating event logistics, maintaining accurate records, organizing files, and communicating schedules and requirements to participants. Program Implementation Support: Support the execution of employee engagement and development activities by facilitating sessions, assisting speakers, monitoring program delivery, collecting feedback, and ensuring smooth event operations. Event Proposal Development: Help conceptualize and prepare employee engagement event proposals, conduct research, collaborate with stakeholders, create multimedia materials for internal communications, and develop a comprehensive event proposal from planning through execution.
